scope: Read-only organization ORBAT staff overview with a dedicated Staff & roles editor
behavior: ORBAT > Staff & roles displays read-only role, rank and personnel summaries, vacancy labels and filled-role counts. Sections collapse; existing descriptions, contact and personnel notes can be read by expanding a role.

Edit staff & roles opens the same selected organization-owned unit in the dedicated editor. View in ORBAT returns to its overview. Staff unit selects headquarters, active subordinates or retained profiles.
The editor has collapsible sections and role cards. Add and duplicate open the new role for editing. Reorder stays within the section.
Section collapse state is shared across the overview and editor and kept per unit while the organization is open. Role-card state is kept separately for reading and editing.
Both views use the same organization draft. Unsaved edits appear in the overview, recovery and save/discard preserve their existing behavior, and switching tabs keeps the selected unit.
Headquarters staff remains editable with no assigned ORBAT. Organizations sharing a map retain separate personnel, and removed unit profiles remain available.

checks: Assign saved ORBAT, click its subordinate, edit identity, role and personnel, and save the organization
ORBAT staff is read-only; direct editing, keyboard collapse, tab context, and unsaved edits share the same unit records
Selections replace one inspector, preserve other unit profiles, and the root edits the owning organization
Organization diagram is fixed against dragging and supports keyboard selection
Role add, duplicate, reorder and remove work in the dedicated editor; both views fit desktop and narrower layouts
Organization headquarters staff can be edited without assigning an ORBAT
Two organizations sharing the same ORBAT keep different unit identities and personnel
Unfinished subordinate edits receive a recovery copy and block organization switching; discard restores saved staff
Saved source changes update the diagram; removed personnel remain editable and matching replacement names never inherit them
Unassigning and reassigning keeps organization-owned personnel
Normal offline exit and reopen retain the assignment, structure and personnel without renderer errors
